letter_text:
To the Office of Admissions, UC San Diego:

I am writing to petition for transfer credit for MATH 1C (Calculus III, 5.0 units), which articulates to MATH 20C under the 2025-2026 De Anza College - UC San Diego articulation agreement, articulation #2. MATH 1D, completing the series, is in progress this term.

I also request individual review of CIS 22B (Intermediate Programming Methodologies in C++, 4.5 units), which has no published articulation to UC San Diego for this major under the 2025-2026 agreement.

Transcript and course syllabi are attached. Thank you for your review.
Sincerely,
[Your name]
